hero.title: Abu Dhabi ITC × Navier — a premium, zero-emission layer for an island capital
hero.subtitle: Abu Dhabi is a city of islands. Navier adds a fast, quiet, electric water layer above today's marine fleet — new high-value corridors and a credible path to decarbonize.
hero.what_we_do_together: We work with the Integrated Transport Centre to introduce a software-defined foiling tier on top of Abu Dhabi's existing marine network. Pioneer II runs all-electric across the island core; Quanta-LR opens the long Gulf corridors that today require a road detour. It is additive — premium service and decarbonization — never a displacement of existing operators.

why_now: Abu Dhabi 2040 and UAE Net Zero 2050 give top-cover for marine fleet renewal, and the emirate's geography — Yas, Saadiyat, Al Maryah, Lulu, Sir Bani Yas and the Corniche — is made for water mobility. Foiling makes those hops fast, smooth and silent, with no charging infrastructure required beyond a berth pedestal, and a hybrid long-range option for the Gulf corridor.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Island-core pilot
featured_routes: Corniche ↔ Al Maryah / CBD — fast electric hop
Downtown ↔ Yas Island — leisure / events corridor
phases.narrative: A five-vessel Pioneer II pilot connecting the Corniche, the CBD islands and the Saadiyat / Yas destinations — proving a quiet, zero-emission premium tier on sheltered inner waters, with clean first-of-class metrics for the authority.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Full island network
featured_routes: Full island mesh — Corniche · Al Maryah · Lulu · Saadiyat · Yas · Reem
Event-day surge service to Yas venues
phases.narrative: We light up the complete Abu Dhabi island network — a true marine layer of the city's transport system, with surge capacity for Yas events and reliable, weather-tolerant island shuttles that foiling makes comfortable year-round.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Gulf corridors: the long range
featured_routes: Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai — inter-emirate Gulf express (Quanta-LR)
Abu Dhabi ↔ Sir Bani Yas / Western Region islands (Quanta-LR)
phases.narrative: Quanta-LR's hybrid range turns the Gulf into part of the network: a smooth single-leg Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai corridor and a direct line to the Western Region's Sir Bani Yas islands — routes that road can't match, with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

close.title: A water layer worthy of an island capital.
close.body: From an island-core pilot to a full network to the Gulf corridors, Navier gives Abu Dhabi a premium, zero-emission marine tier — additive to the existing fleet, and a credible path to the emirate's 2040 and Net Zero goals.
